coreItems.name: Compact Ammo
coreItems.description: Stuff a few more of these compact rounds into each magazine and they have a bit less recoil as well.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 GK2 突击步枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 压缩过体积的弹药能让弹匣多容纳几发，其产生的后坐力也更小。

coreItems.name: Electrifying Reload
coreItems.description: Embedded capacitors electrocute targets from the inside when you reload. However all that tech reduces total ammo and magazine capacity.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 GK2 突击步枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 弹头内置的电容会在换弹时在敌人体内释放电流，但你要为这高科技牺牲不少备弹和载弹。

coreItems.name: AI Stability Engine
coreItems.description: It's like it knows what you are going to do before you do it, compensating for all recoil and bullet spread. The system requires a lower rate of fire and the fin-stabilized rounds do less direct damage but give a bonus to weakpoint hits.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 GK2 突击步枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 就像能预测你下一步行动一般修正所有后坐力和子弹散布。这个系统需要以较低的射速才能正常工作，射出的尾翼稳定弹头造成的直接伤害更少，但具有更高的弱点伤害加成。

coreItems.name: Homebrew Powder
coreItems.description: More damage on average but it's a bit inconsistent.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 GK2 突击步枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 平均伤害提升，但单发伤害存在浮动。

coreItems.name: Overclocked Firing Mechanism
coreItems.description: More bullets faster and it kicks like a mule.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 GK2 突击步枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 更快射子弹，后坐如骡翻。

coreItems.name: Gas Rerouting
coreItems.description: Increases the weapon's rate of fire without affecting performance and helps with magazine ejection as well.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 GK2 突击步枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 提升武器射速的同时不影响武器性能，弹匣也能更快地弹出。

coreItems.name: Bullets of Mercy
coreItems.description: Deal bonus damage to burning, stunned, electrocuted, frozen, or poisoned targets
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 GK2 突击步枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 对受点燃、击晕、触电、冻结、中毒影响的目标造成额外伤害。

coreItems.name: Big Bertha
coreItems.description: Extensive tweaks give a huge bump in raw damage at the cost of ammo capacity and fire rate.
coreItems.weaponZh: “雷暴云砧” 重型双管机炮
coreItems.descriptionZh: 大量的调整使得武器基础伤害有了巨大飞跃，但代价为降低备弹量和射速。

coreItems.name: Carpet Bomber
coreItems.description: A few tweaks here and there and the Autocannon can now shoot HE rounds! Direct damage is lower but the increased splash damage and range lets you saturate an area like no other weapon can.
coreItems.weaponZh: “雷暴云砧” 重型双管机炮
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过一番调整后，机炮现在能够发射高爆弹药了！虽然直接伤害变低了，但换来的溅射伤害和范围提升，令你的压制力无出其右。

coreItems.name: Composite Drums
coreItems.description: Lighter weight materials means you can carry even more ammo!
coreItems.weaponZh: “雷暴云砧” 重型双管机炮
coreItems.descriptionZh: 更轻的材料意味着你甚至能携带更多的弹药！

coreItems.name: Combat Mobility
coreItems.description: Fancy custom ammo drums improve weapon balance making it more accurate and easier to handle on the move while the improved feed motor increases the speed with which the max fire rate is reached. All this however comes at the cost of magazine capacity.
coreItems.weaponZh: “雷暴云砧” 重型双管机炮
coreItems.descriptionZh: 定制的弹鼓能提升武器的平衡性，使武器精准度和移动时的操作性更上一层楼，而改进的供弹马达则提升了武器达到最大射速的速度。然而这一系列的改动牺牲了部分的弹鼓容量。

coreItems.name: Neurotoxin Payload
coreItems.description: Channel your inner war criminal by mixing some neurotoxin into the explosive compound. The rounds deal less damage and you can carry fewer of them, but affected bugs move slower and take lots of damage over time.
coreItems.weaponZh: “雷暴云砧” 重型双管机炮
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过将一些神经毒素混入爆炸性化合物来释放你心中的恶魔。这种弹药只能造成更少的伤害，载弹量也会减少，但受其影响的虫子移动得更慢，且会受到大量持续伤害。

coreItems.name: Splintering Shells
coreItems.description: Specially designed shells splinter into smaller pieces increasing the splash damage range.
coreItems.weaponZh: “雷暴云砧” 重型双管机炮
coreItems.descriptionZh: 特制的机炮弹药能够迸裂出更细小的弹片，使溅射的伤害范围更大。

coreItems.name: Minimal Clips
coreItems.description: Increase clip capacity and speed up reloads by getting rid of dead weight on the clips.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过去掉弹夹上不必要的重量，在为弹药创造更多空间的同时提升换弹速度。

coreItems.name: Supercooling Chamber
coreItems.description: Take the M1000's focus mode to the extreme by supercooling the rounds before firing to improve their acceleration through the coils, but the extra coolant in the clips limits how much ammo you can bring.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 开火前将弹药过冷却以提升通过线圈时的加速度，从而将 M1000 经典型步枪的瞄准模式发挥到极致，但额外的冷却剂限制了你能携带的弹药数量。

coreItems.name: Electrocuting Focus Shots
coreItems.description: Embedded capacitors in a copper core carry the electric charge from the EM coils used for focus shots and will electrocute the target at the cost of a reduced focus shot damage bonus.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 内置在铜制弹头里的电容能携带瞄准射击所使用的电磁线圈产生的电荷，命中目标时会使其触电，代价是瞄准射击伤害加成降低。

coreItems.name: Hipster
coreItems.description: A less powerful round together with a rebalancing of weight distribution, enlarged vents and a reshaped grip result in a rifle that is more controllable when hip-firing in quick succession but at the cost of pure damage output. As an added bonus you can carry more of the new ammunition.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过重调配重、加大散热口、重塑握把造型的步枪，搭配中间威力弹，你就获得了一把伤害更低，但操控性更为优异、更适合快速连续腰射的步枪。你能携带的弹药也变多了。

coreItems.name: Hoverclock
coreItems.description: Your movement slows down for a few seconds while using focus mode in the air.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 在空中使用瞄准模式时短暂减慢你的下落速度。

coreItems.name: Active Stability System
coreItems.description: Focus faster and without slowing down but all that fancy tech limits how quickly you can reload.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 不用放慢脚步就能瞄准而且瞄准更快，但是这些花哨科技限制了你换弹的速度。

coreItems.name: Composite Casings
coreItems.description: Lighter rounds that permit a shorter delay between bursts and you can carry a few more of them as well. What's not to like?
coreItems.descriptionZh: 更轻的弹药让每次射击之间的间隔缩短不少，而且你还能带更多弹药。为什么不爱呢？

coreItems.name: Compact Mags
coreItems.description: You can carry even more ammo but the rate of fire needs to be toned back to avoid a jam and please take more care while reloading.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 你能带更多的弹药了，但为了避免弹匣卡弹，武器射速需要被调低，同时在换弹时也需要更加仔细。

coreItems.name: Electro Minelets
coreItems.description: After impacting terrain, these high-tech bullets convert into electro minelets that will electrocute anything unfortunate enough to come close. However, they don't last forever and the rounds themselves take more space in the magazine and deal less direct damage.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 此类高科技子弹会在击中岩体后形成放电陷阱，电击靠近的任何东西。然而产生的陷阱并不能永久存在，而且弹药本身更占弹匣空间，造成的直接伤害也更低。

coreItems.name: Full Chamber Seal
coreItems.description: Meticulous sealing lets you get a bit more power out of each round and the attention to detail improves how easily the magazine slots in.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 细致的密封略微提升了子弹射出时的出膛速度，细节的优化提升了拔插弹匣时的顺滑手感。

coreItems.name: Experimental Rounds
coreItems.description: A new shape to the bullet delivers a lot more damage but its odd size means fewer rounds in the clip and a bit less ammo overall.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 全新形状的弹头能够带来更多伤害，但其非常规的形状也导致弹匣和口袋内能装的弹药减少了一点。

coreItems.name: Micro Flechettes
coreItems.description: Convert the BRT to fire small flechettes instead of slugs. Increases overall ammo and magazine size as well as reducing recoil but at the cost of raw damage.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将连发手枪射出的弹头替换为微型飞镖，提升整体备弹量和弹匣容量的同时降低后坐力，但基础伤害低了不少。

coreItems.name: Lead Spray
coreItems.description: It ain't pretty but this overclock will tear apart anything that gets close, though it gets a bit iffy at range.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 改得丑是丑了点，但这个超频模组能让你把所有近距离的目标都射成筛子。我们最好尽量不去讨论它的射程。

coreItems.name: Heat Pipe
coreItems.description: By channeling exhaust heat back into the charge chamber a shot can be charged faster while using less energy. Unfortunately this process generates a lot more heat.
coreItems.weaponZh: 实验性等离子蓄能手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将武器排出的热量引导回充能膛室，改善武器充能的速度和能量消耗。但这样改装会极大提升武器产生的热量。

coreItems.name: Overcharger
coreItems.description: Pushing the EPC to the limit will give you a significant increase in charge shot damage and a boost in the size of the explosion but at the cost of thermal efficiency and energy consumption.
coreItems.weaponZh: 实验性等离子蓄能手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将蓄能手枪的性能推向极致，显著提升其充能射击的伤害与爆炸范围，但热效率和能量消耗会变差不少。

coreItems.name: Energy Rerouting
coreItems.description: A masterwork of engineering that improves charge speed and energy efficiency without affecting overall performance!
coreItems.weaponZh: 实验性等离子蓄能手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过大师级别的工程改进，在不影响武器整体表现的情况下提升了充能速度和能量效率！

coreItems.name: Magnetic Cooling Unit
coreItems.description: A high-tech solution to cleanly improve the cooling rate. The result is an increased number of shots that can be fired before overheating, a faster recovery from an overheat and an extended duration that a full charge can be maintained.
coreItems.weaponZh: 实验性等离子蓄能手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过高科技手段完美地提升了冷却速率。其结果是在过热前能开火的次数更多，从过热中恢复的速度更快，以及充能射击可以维持住更长时间。

coreItems.name: Heavy Hitter
coreItems.description: Some extensive tweaking to how the shots are prepared can increase the pure damage of the weapon but at the cost of more heat per shot and a reduced battery size.
coreItems.weaponZh: 实验性等离子蓄能手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 基于电浆生成方式进行的大幅改动提升了武器的直接伤害，但每次射击会积累更多热量，电池容量也相应减小。

coreItems.name: Persistent Plasma
coreItems.description: By changing how the plasma is layered within the charged projectile a slow and persistent discharge can be achieved upon impact. Any enemy entering this field will be slowed while continuously taking damage. However, this does reduce the instant damage done.
coreItems.weaponZh: 实验性等离子蓄能手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过改变电浆在充能发射物中的分层方式，使得发射物在爆炸时会缓慢且持续地放电。任何进入放电区域内的敌人都会被减速并持续受到伤害，但爆炸时的直接伤害会降低不少。

coreItems.name: Light-Weight Magazines
coreItems.description: It's amazing how much material can be removed without affecting anything and lighter magazines means more magazines and faster reloading.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 能从弹匣上拆出这么多的无用材料既可称之为奇迹又令人发指，而更轻的弹匣意味着带得更多、换得更快。

coreItems.name: Stunner
coreItems.description: Heavier rounds allow for stun chance on all body parts, not just weakpoints. Shooting already stunned enemies with this overclock will deal extra damage.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 质量更重的弹丸使得在击中弱点以外的身体部位时也有几率击晕敌人，同时它还能对已被击晕的敌人造成额外伤害。

coreItems.name: Mini Shells
coreItems.description: Smaller shells designed around a new charge type reduce recoil and increase overall ammo and magazine capacity at the cost of raw damage.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 一种基于新型火药所设计的小尺寸霰弹。虽然后坐力小了不少，武器载弹量和备弹也提升了，但每发霰弹的伤害也变低了。

coreItems.name: Cycle Overload
coreItems.description: Heavy modification to the chamber greatly increases the maximum rate of fire and increases raw damage but reduces the weapon's accuracy and reload speed as a consequence.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 对枪膛的大型改造大大提高了最高射速和基础伤害，但降低了武器的精度和换弹速度。

coreItems.name: Magnetic Pellet Alignment
coreItems.description: Electromagnets in the chamber greatly reduces shot spread and increase weakpoint damage at the cost of a slower rate of fire.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 枪膛内加装的电磁铁虽然限制了武器射速，但弹丸的扩散被大幅缩小，并提供额外的弱点伤害。

coreItems.name: Improved Thermal Efficiency
coreItems.description: Get all you can from your fuel and lose pressure slower from the main chamber.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 最大化利用冷冻剂效能，同时减缓主储舱的压力流失速率。

coreItems.name: Tuned Cooler
coreItems.description: Freeze things faster at the cost of a slower pump and turbine.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 冻结速度更快，但冷泵和涡轮机的响应和运行速度更慢。

coreItems.name: Flow Rate Expansion
coreItems.description: A low volume high pressure chamber paired with a high power pump increase the flow rate and repressurization speed but lower the max duration of sustained flow.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 低容量高压储舱搭配上一个大功率加压泵，能够提升冷冻剂流速和压力恢复速率，但会降低最大可持续喷射时间。

coreItems.name: Ice Storm
coreItems.description: A change in the fuel mixture along with some heavy cooler unit tweaks means a lot more damage especially to frozen targets. However, freezing takes longer and the capacity of the pressure chamber is reduced.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 改良的冷冻剂配方以及对制冷单元的大量调整，使得造成的伤害，尤其是对被冻结目标的伤害得到极大提升。然而，冻结目标所需要的时间更长，压力仓的容量也更小。

coreItems.name: Ice Spear
coreItems.description: Pressing the reload button dumps all the fluid in the chamber directly into the turbine, flash freezing it and launching an ice projectile. Side effects include an increased recharge delay and of course the large amount of fuel used.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 按下换弹键将储罐内所有冷冻剂直接压进涡轮，瞬间冷却后射出一个冰锥。副作用包括延长压力恢复延迟、以及大量消耗冷冻剂。

coreItems.name: Snowball
coreItems.description: Pressing the reload button shoots all the cryofuel in the chamber at once as an AoE cryo-projectile. Besides the very large amount of fuel consumed, the operation overloads the whole system resulting in a much longer delay before regaining pressure and the modifications restrict the total amount of fuel you can carry.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 按下换弹键将储舱内全部冷冻剂转换为一个具有范围冰冻效果的发射物并发射出去。这项操作除了冷冻剂消耗量非常大之外，同时也会超载整个系统，导致压力恢复前有一个明显更长的延迟，各种调整也限制了你能携带的冷冻剂总量。

coreItems.name: Cryo Minelets
coreItems.description: After impacting terrain, these high-tech bullets convert into cryo minelets that will super-cool anything that comes close. However, they don't last forever and the rounds themselves take more space in the magazine and deal less direct damage.
coreItems.weaponZh: 朱可夫 NUK17 双持冲锋枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 此类高科技子弹会在击中岩体后形成冰冻陷阱，迅速冻结靠近的任何东西。然而产生的陷阱并不能永久存在，而且弹药本身更占弹匣空间，造成的直接伤害也更低。

coreItems.name: Custom Casings
coreItems.description: Fit more of these custom rounds in each magazine but at small reduction in the rate of fire.
coreItems.weaponZh: 朱可夫 NUK17 双持冲锋枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 在每个弹匣里塞进更多的定制弹药，但射速会略微降低。

coreItems.name: Gas Recycling
coreItems.description: Special hardened bullets combined with rerouting escaping gasses back into the chamber greatly increases the raw damage of the weapon but makes it more difficult to control and removes any bonus to weakpoint hits.
coreItems.weaponZh: 朱可夫 NUK17 双持冲锋枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 特殊的硬质子弹加上将开火时的逃逸气流重引回膛极大地提升了武器的基础伤害，但也让武器更难以控制，此外，这种子弹也无法对弱点造成任何额外伤害。

coreItems.name: Embedded Detonators
coreItems.description: Special bullets contain micro-explosives that detonate when you reload the weapon at the cost of total ammo, magazine capacity and direct damage.
coreItems.weaponZh: 朱可夫 NUK17 双持冲锋枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 内置微型炸药的特制子弹，会在你换弹时会引爆。代价是降低备弹量、弹匣容量和直接伤害。

coreItems.name: Minimal Magazines
coreItems.description: By filing away unnecessary material from the magazines you've made them lighter, and that means they pop out faster when reloading. Also the rounds can move more freely increasing the max rate of fire slightly.
coreItems.weaponZh: 朱可夫 NUK17 双持冲锋枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 移除弹匣上非必要的结构材料，更轻的匣体让换弹时弹匣能更快弹出，同时更加顺畅的供弹变相地略微提升了射速。

coreItems.name: Compact Feed Valves
coreItems.description: The smaller mechanism allows for greater tank capacity and more fuel at the cost of reload speed and operational range.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 更紧凑的供油阀结构给油罐和燃油匀了不少位置，但武器的装填速度和射程都受到了影响。

coreItems.name: Face Melter
coreItems.description: This crazy bit of tweaking will give a big boost in damage and flow rate but at the cost of operational range and tank capacity.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 这个疯狂的改装能极大提升伤害和燃油流速，但是射程和油罐容量都会降低。

coreItems.name: Lighter Tanks
coreItems.description: Lighter weight gear means more fuel and sandwiches.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 更轻的装备意味着更多的燃料和三明治。

coreItems.name: Fuel Stream Diffuser
coreItems.description: Increases operational range but decreases the fuel flow rate.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 提升射程但降低燃油喷射速率。

coreItems.name: Sticky Fuel
coreItems.description: Special fuel mixture extends the duration and damage of Sticky Flames but at the cost of tank capacity and total fuel.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 特制的复合燃油提升了火墙的持续时间和伤害，但是会让油罐容量和燃油总量减少。

coreItems.name: Sticky Additive
coreItems.description: Special additive compound extends the Sticky Flame duration and increases direct damage.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 特殊的化合助剂增加了火焰的直接伤害，提升了火墙的持续时间。

coreItems.name: Compact Feed Mechanism
coreItems.description: More space left for ammo at the cost of a reduced rate of fire.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 以供弹速度（即射速）降低为代价，为弹药腾出一些空间。

coreItems.name: Thinned Drum Walls
coreItems.description: Stuff more bullets into the ammo drum by thinning the material in non-critical areas.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 削减弹鼓非重要区域的材料厚度，从而塞入更多弹药。

coreItems.name: Lead Storm
coreItems.description: Pushing things to the limit this overclock greatly increases damage output at the cost of consistently stunning targets and the kickback makes it almost impossible to move.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将武器性能发挥到极致，极大地提升伤害输出，但无法稳定击晕目标，且后坐力让你基本无法移动。

coreItems.name: Exhaust Vectoring
coreItems.description: Increases damage at a cost to accuracy.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 牺牲准度来提升伤害。

coreItems.name: A Little More Oomph!
coreItems.description: Get the most out of each shot without compromising any of the gun's systems.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 在不影响武器性能的情况下，将每一发子弹的效率发挥到极致。

coreItems.name: Burning Hell
coreItems.description: Turn the area just in front of the minigun into an even worse place by venting all the combustion gasses forward. However, it does overheat rather quickly.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将所有高温气体都排到枪口前，从而让机枪正前方的区域变成更恐怖的地狱。但这也让机枪会更快过热。

coreItems.name: Bullet Hell
coreItems.description: Special bullets that ricochet off all surfaces and even enemies going on to hit nearby targets. However they deal less damage and are less accurate overall.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 特制的子弹会在接触到平面（包括敌人）时反弹，从而再次命中附近的目标。但子弹的整体精度和造成的伤害降低了一些。

coreItems.name: Pack Rat
coreItems.description: You found a way to pack away two more rounds somewhere.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 40mm 便携式榴弹发射器
coreItems.descriptionZh: 你找到了在什么地方多塞两发弹药的方法。

coreItems.name: Compact Rounds
coreItems.description: Smaller and lighter rounds means more rounds in the pocket at the cost of the explosion's effective radius and damage.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 40mm 便携式榴弹发射器
coreItems.descriptionZh: 你可以在身上多揣几发这种更轻便小巧的榴弹，但其爆炸范围和伤害和普通榴弹相比显得相形见绌。

coreItems.name: Fat Boy
coreItems.description: Big and deadly and dirty. Too bad plutonium is so heavy that you can only take a few rounds with you. And remember to take care with the fallout.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 40mm 便携式榴弹发射器
coreItems.descriptionZh: 这玩意体积大、十分致命，且充满放射性。可惜钚元素质量过大导致你的可携带的弹药量十分有限。一定小心爆炸时产生的辐射。

coreItems.name: Clean Sweep
coreItems.description: Increases the explosion radius and damage without any unwanted effects.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 40mm 便携式榴弹发射器
coreItems.descriptionZh: 在没有任何负面影响的情况下提升 爆炸范围和伤害。

coreItems.name: RJ250 Compound
coreItems.description: Use explosions to launch yourself and your teammates into the air.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 40mm 便携式榴弹发射器
coreItems.descriptionZh: 利用爆炸的冲击波把你自己和队友推向空中。

coreItems.name: Hyper Propellant
coreItems.description: New super-high velocity projectiles trade explosive range for raw damage in a tight area. The increased weight of the rounds also limits how many you can carry.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 40mm 便携式榴弹发射器
coreItems.descriptionZh: 全新的超高速发射物以爆炸范围换取了小范围内直接伤害的提升。但更重的弹药质量限制了你能携带的弹药量。

coreItems.name: Light-Weight Cases
coreItems.description: Bring more ammo with you and slam those cases in faster!
coreItems.descriptionZh: 带的弹药更多，换匣的速度更快！

coreItems.name: Stronger Plasma Current
coreItems.description: By improving the node's efficiency you can up the raw damage without too much fuss and it lasts a bit longer too!
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过简单的节点效率优化，等离子线的基础伤害和持续寿命都有小幅度的提升！

coreItems.name: High Voltage Crossover
coreItems.description: By passing an electric current through the plasma, the beam electrocutes anything it touches but the bulky hardware limits magazine capacity.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过向等离子体通入电流，等离子线能让接触到的所有东西触电，但是笨重的硬件限制了弹匣容量。

coreItems.name: Inferno
coreItems.description: Turn your Breach Cutter into a tool of burning death and destruction at the cost of direct damage and armor breaking. As a bonus the extreme internal heating keeps the targets burning for an extended period.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 以减弱直接伤害和护甲破坏为代价，换取射线经过之处横尸遍野，寸草不生。同时大量的热量蓄积在敌人体内，能够让其在一段时间内维持燃烧。

coreItems.name: Return to Sender
coreItems.description: Holding down the trigger after the line leaves the gun activates a remote connection which on the release of the trigger causes the line to change direction and move back towards the gun.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 发射期间按住开火按钮将激活等离子线控制，可以通过松开开火按钮使等离子线立刻向反方向移动。

coreItems.name: Roll Control
coreItems.description: A few tweaks to the launcher cause it to add roll to the projectile after it is ejected thus covering a larger area as it travels. Holding down the trigger as the line leaves the gun activates a remote connection which lets you steer the projectile as long as the trigger is held down. On the release of the trigger the connection is broken and the projectile continues in a straight line. The projectile is also able to travel further before collapsing.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过少许调整的发射器能让射出的等离子线具备旋转功能，从而在飞行途中覆盖更大的范围。发射期间按住开火按钮可远程操控射线，松开开火按钮连接便会中断，射线则会继续沿直线飞行。另外等离子线在坍缩前的飞行距离也相应延长。

coreItems.name: Spinning Death
coreItems.description: These modified plasma nodes convert most of the forward momentum into angular momentum stretching out the beam and continuously doing damage to the immediate area where it was launched. The nodes run for a longer duration but deal less damage every second. Due to the weight both magazine and total capacity is greatly reduced.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过改造的等离子节点能够将大部分前向动量转化为角动量，进而拉长等离子线，对附近范围持续造成伤害。等离子节点的持续时间也更长，但是每秒造成的伤害更低，弹匣的容量和弹药携带量也极大降低。

coreItems.name: Chain Hit
coreItems.description: Any shot that hits a weakspot has a chance to ricochet into a nearby enemy.
coreItems.weaponZh: 苏巴特 120 半自动手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 命中弱点的子弹将有几率弹射到附近的敌人身上。

coreItems.name: Oversized Magazine
coreItems.description: Custom magazine that can fit a lot more ammo but it's a bit unwieldy and takes longer to reload.
coreItems.weaponZh: 苏巴特 120 半自动手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 定制的弹匣能够容纳更多弹药，但有些笨拙，延长了换弹时间。

coreItems.name: Explosive Reload
coreItems.description: Micro-explosives that explode inside hit targets when you reload. However, these fancy bullets come at the cost of total ammo and magazine capacity.
coreItems.weaponZh: 苏巴特 120 半自动手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 内含微型炸药的弹头，当你换弹时在命中目标体内引爆。但这些花哨弹药带来的代价是备弹量和弹匣容量的降低。

coreItems.name: Automatic Fire
coreItems.description: Fully automatic action, watch out for the recoil.
coreItems.weaponZh: 苏巴特 120 半自动手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 在霍克斯星上开始你的全自动行为。后坐力警告。

coreItems.name: Homebrew Powder
coreItems.description: More damage on average but it's a bit inconsistent.
coreItems.weaponZh: 苏巴特 120 半自动手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 平均伤害提升，但单发伤害存在浮动。

coreItems.name: Tranquilizer Rounds
coreItems.description: Part bullet, part syringe, these rounds are very effective at stunning most enemies and slowing down the rest.
coreItems.weaponZh: 苏巴特 120 半自动手枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 弹头与针头合二为一，被击中的敌人不是被弹头击晕就是被药剂减速。

coreItems.name: Six Shooter
coreItems.description: An updated casing profile lets you squeeze 2 more rounds into the cylinder and take a few more rounds with you, but all that filing and drilling has compromised the accuracy of the weapon and it takes longer to reload.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过对弹壳形状的优化，你不仅能往弹巢内硬多塞两发子弹，还匀出了位置多携带几发弹药，但对子弹进行字面意义上的“钻研”还是影响到了其精准度与装填时间。

coreItems.name: Elephant Rounds
coreItems.description: Heavy tweaking has made it possible to use modified autocannon rounds in the revolver! The damage is crazy but so is the recoil and you can't carry as many rounds. Also, only 3 rounds fit in the gun and reload time is a bit slower but base accuracy is improved.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 大量改动成功把左轮手枪魔改成了小型手持机炮！每发的伤害和后坐力都直冲天花板，但你的裤兜里也塞不下和之前一样多的弹药了。另外这把枪现在一次只能装入 3 发子弹，装填时间也更长，但至少基础精准度有一定提升。

coreItems.name: Chain Hit
coreItems.description: Any shot that hits a weakspot has a high chance to ricochet into a nearby enemy.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 命中弱点的子弹将有很高几率弹射到附近的敌人身上。

coreItems.name: Magic Bullets
coreItems.description: Smaller, bouncy bullets ricochet off hard surfaces, hitting nearby enemies like magic! Overall, the damage of the weapon is reduced, but you can carry a few more rounds due to their compact size.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 更小的弹性子弹在命中坚硬表面时会进行弹射，像魔法一般击中附近的敌人！总的来说，由于弹药的尺寸缩小，武器的伤害降低了，但能携带的备弹变多了。

coreItems.name: Homebrew Powder
coreItems.description: More damage on average but it's a bit inconsistent.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 平均伤害提升，但单发伤害存在浮动。

coreItems.name: Volatile Bullets
coreItems.description: Fuel on the fire! These rounds are extremely effective against burning targets but at the cost of direct damage dealt to unaffected creatures.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 火上浇油！这些子弹对着火的目标特别有效，代价是对未着火目标造成的直接伤害降低。

coreItems.name: Shaped Shells
coreItems.description: Specially shaped shells result in a much tighter shot, but you can't carry quite as many of them.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 特制形状的霰弹弹壳使得弹丸散布更加密集，但也不方便携带。

coreItems.name: Jumbo Shells
coreItems.description: These large shells pack a lot more charge for a big increase in damage but they also take up more space so total ammo is limited.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 更大的弹壳能容纳更多的装药，大幅提升霰弹伤害，但也占用了更多空间，限制了可携带的备弹量。

coreItems.name: Stuffed Shells
coreItems.description: With a bit of patience and some luck you can get one more pellet and a few more grains of powder into each shell without affecting the gun's performance or losing an eye in the process.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过一点耐心和运气加成，你设法往每颗霰弹内多塞了一枚弹丸和一点火药，不影响武器性能的同时还不会炸膛瞎一只眼睛。

coreItems.name: Double Barrel
coreItems.description: Unload both barrels at once, no regrets. As an added bonus the simultaneous firing of both shells has an amplifying effect on the blast wave.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 双管齐射，输出爆炸，射空成为团队笑话。双倍的射击冲力同时也提升了冲击波的强度。

coreItems.name: Compact Shells
coreItems.description: You can carry a few more of these compact shells in your pockets and they are a bit faster to reload with.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 体积紧凑的压缩弹药，让你带得更多、装填更快。

coreItems.name: Special Powder
coreItems.description: Less like gunpowder and more like rocketfuel, this mixture gives a hell of a kick that you can use to get places.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 比起火药来说更像火箭燃料，这种混合物能产生巨大的冲击力，让你能用来四处移动。

coreItems.name: Light-Weight Rounds
coreItems.description: They don't hit quite as hard, and can't handle fast fire rates but you sure can carry a lot more of them!
coreItems.descriptionZh: 伤害不那么高，射速不那么快，但你现在可以带一堆弹药！

coreItems.name: Well Oiled Machine
coreItems.description: When you need a little more sustained damage.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 当你的持续伤害需要助点力。

coreItems.name: EM Refire Booster
coreItems.description: Use the electron circuit of the SMG to boost its fire rate and damage but the accuracy suffers as a result.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 用伏特冲锋枪自带的电路来提升射速和伤害，但会降低精准度。

coreItems.name: Super-Slim Rounds
coreItems.description: Same power but in a smaller package giving slightly better accuracy and letting you fit a few more rounds in each magazine.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 子弹的尺寸更小，但威力不减，略微提升精准度的同时，也能让你在每个弹匣里能多装入几发弹药。

coreItems.name: Turret EM Discharge
coreItems.description: Shoot a turret to turn it into the epicenter of an electric explosion! The bullet modifications unfortunately also lower the direct damage and magazine capacity.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 射击炮台使其释放电磁爆炸！不幸的是对子弹的改动降低了其直接伤害和弹匣容量。

coreItems.name: Micro-Conductor Add-On
coreItems.description: Micro-conductors have been added to your bullets, enabling them to add electric currents to platforms and Sentries on impact. Additionally, electrified Sentries work as nodes, creating an electric arc between them. Conductor Bullets are bigger and require a modified firing mechanism, reducing ammo capacity and fire rate.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 给弹头添加微型导体，使其能为被命中的哨戒炮和注胶混凝土平台通电。除此之外，被通电的炮台将成为电弧节点，并在相互之间产生电弧。不过额外的导体增大了子弹尺寸，使其需要专门的发射结构，弹匣容量和射速都受限制。

coreItems.name: Fragmentation Missiles
coreItems.description: With a thicker casing your missiles spread more fragments at higher speeds, increasing AoE efficiency
coreItems.descriptionZh: 更厚的外壳使导弹以更高的速度播撒更多破片，从而提高范围伤害的效果。

coreItems.name: Salvo Module
coreItems.description: Enables your weapon to load up to 9 missiles and launch them at once! As an added bonus the overloaded exhaust ports increase missile velocity and boost damage based on how many missiles are in the salvo. However the missiles in the salvo cannot be guided.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 能让武器填装至多 9 枚飞弹，并一次性全射出去！同时，飞弹的飞行速度和伤害会根据已装填（并牢牢堵在枪管内）的飞弹数量提升，但是齐射时射出的飞弹将无法被引导。

coreItems.name: Rocket Barrage
coreItems.description: Unleash a torrent of small unguided rockets. What they lack in sophistication and explosive power is more than made up for in the sheer volume and rate of fire.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 射出成片直线飞行的小型飞弹，无制导功能与低爆炸威力的短板被其纯粹的数量与更高的射速所弥补。

coreItems.name: Jet Fuel Homebrew
coreItems.description: Grandpa's recipe. Highly unstable and heavy, but works like a charm! Your missiles get a much higher top speed and reach it instantly. The extra energy greatly improves direct damage but all that extra fuel reduces the missile payload capacity. Due to the extra weight both magazine and total ammo capacity are also reduced.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 爷爷的秘方。又重又不稳定，但是用起来很上头！你的飞弹可以瞬间加速到更大的最高速度。额外的动能大幅增加了直接伤害，但额外的燃料减少了飞弹的炸药装药量。更大的重量也使得弹匣容量以及备弹量减少了。

coreItems.name: Minelayer System
coreItems.description: When your missiles hit the ground they are planted as mines that explode when damaged or if enemies are in close proximity. When setup as mines the warheads explode with significantly more force over a larger area but keep in mind that these missiles do not have guidance. The total ammo capacity is slightly reduced.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 当你的飞弹碰到地面时会像地雷一样埋在地面，在敌人靠近或被击中时引爆。当飞弹设置为地雷后，爆炸时会在大范围内产生强力冲击波，但请注意，这种新型飞弹没有制导系统，总备弹量也被减少了。

coreItems.name: Plasma Burster Missiles
coreItems.description: Turn the battlefield into a plasma apocalypse with these penetrating multi-burst missiles! They fly slower, don't hit as hard, and there is a limit to how many can be controlled at one time, but in the right hands even a single missile can do a lot of damage.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 用上这些高穿透性的连环爆炸飞弹，你就可以把战场改造成等离子大灾变的现场！它们虽然飞得慢一些，伤害也不那么给力，并且限制了可同时引导的飞弹数量。不过只要用的够溜，一发飞弹便可以造成大量伤害。

coreItems.name: Overtuned Feed Mechanism
coreItems.description: With some slight tinkering, both your weapon and projectiles are faster.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过一些微调，你的武器射速和飞弹速度都变快了。

coreItems.name: Disperser Compound
coreItems.description: Charged shots break apart into more fragments on impact and each fragment is more potent, however the initial damage of the charged projectile impact is reduced.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 充能射击在受到冲击时会破裂成更多的碎块，且每个碎块的威力都更大，但是充能射击其本身的直接伤害会降低。

coreItems.name: Goo Bomber Special
coreItems.description: The addition of finely tuned timed separation compounds cause the charged shots to leave a trail of sludge as they fly through the air. However the projectile depletes its mass as it flies, dealing less impact damage as fragments separate and completely expiring once all fragments are dropped.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过添加精细调整过的定时分离化合物，使得充能射击射出的蚀泥会在飞行的同时撒下蚀泥坑。然而随着蚀泥在飞行过程中逐渐消耗其质量，其直接伤害也会随之减少，直至撒完所有黏液并消失。

coreItems.name: AG Mixture
coreItems.description: Anti-gravity pellets suspended in the sludge let the projectiles fly further and faster.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 混合在泥浆中的反重力颗粒让发射物飞得更远更快。

coreItems.name: Hydrogen Ion Additive
coreItems.description: Experimental additive that activates on impact gives a small improvement to the corrosive DoT and slowdown effect of direct hits.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 添加了会在受到冲击时发生反应的实验性添加剂，略微提升了蚀泥在直接命中敌人时造成的持续腐蚀伤害和减速效果。

coreItems.name: Volatile Impact Mixture
coreItems.description: Special mixture greatly increases projectile impact damage. However the volatile compound evaporates quicker, reducing the duration of the corrosive and slowdown effects as well as the puddle lifetime.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 添加这种特殊添加剂后的发射物的直接伤害大幅增加。但由于最终的化合物挥发性较强，导致腐蚀和减速效果的持续时间缩短，蚀泥坑存在时间也是。

coreItems.name: Sludge Blast
coreItems.description: The charged shot cohesion is disrupted on firing, instantly shooting out fast-moving fragments in a shotgun-like blast. While spectacular the modifications result in reduced ammo capacity and an extended reload process.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 在充能射击时破坏发射物的聚合力，瞬间射出霰弹般的高速碎块。然而这些改动降低了备弹量，还延长了重新装填的过程。

coreItems.name: Rewiring Mod
coreItems.description: By rewiring the thermal systems into a secondary cell and connecting it to the primary battery, your weapon can convert the energy from overheating into ammo. However this reduces the maximum capacity of the primary battery significantly.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过将热量系统转接到一个与主电池相连的副电池上，你的武器可以将过热时的能量转化为弹药。然而这会大幅减少主电池的最大容量。

coreItems.name: Impact Deflection
coreItems.description: Tinkering with the particle density makes your projectiles react on impact with armor and surfaces, making them bounce! However the rate of fire needs to be reduced to keep the gun from exploding in your hands.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过对粒子密度的调整，你的发射物可以在撞击物体表面或虫子的甲壳时发生反应，使其进行弹跳！但是武器的射速必须调低，防止它在你手里炸开花。

coreItems.name: Thermal Liquid Coolant
coreItems.description: With a liquid coolant fitted to the weapons thermal systems it transfers heat more efficiently, accelerating its cooling rate and reducing heat per shot.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将冷却液添加到武器的散热系统中可更有效地传导热量，提升冷却效率的同时降低每次射击时产生的热量。

coreItems.name: Thermal Exhaust Feedback
coreItems.description: Feeding the thermal exhaust back into the system transfers the heat generated after a 50% threshold to the plasma, making it increasingly hot. The modifications means more heat generated and it takes longer to get rid of during overheat.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过把废热重导回系统中，使得武器热量达到上限的 50% 时，回导的热量将传递到等离子体上，让它变得更加灼热。但这项改动会导致更高的热能堆积，过热后的散热时间也会变长。

coreItems.name: Overtuned Particle Accelerator
coreItems.description: The particle accelerator has been tuned way over safety standards to push the damage output to the limit! The modifications comes with a price to overall stability of the weapon and increased heat generation.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将粒子加速器调整至远超安全标准的程度，伤害输出提升到了极限！然而武器的总体稳定性以及热量积累速率变差不少。

coreItems.name: Aggressive Venting
coreItems.description: Directional vents burn everything around you and send enemies running when the weapon overheats. They also reduce the overheat recovery time.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 定向分布的散热孔能在武器过热时点燃你身边的一切，并让敌人仓皇逃窜。这种散热方法也能显著缩短过热时间。

coreItems.name: Shield Battery Booster
coreItems.description: Plugging your shield directly into the weapon battery boosts the plasma feed and density significantly while at full shield and improves total ammo and rate of fire at all times. However the extra energy generates more heat and overheating the weapon will short circuit your shield.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将你的护盾能量直接导入武器电池以显著增加等离子体的流量和密度，在满护盾时会一直提高总弹量和射速。但额外的能量会产生额外的热量，而且武器过热会使你的护盾短路。

coreItems.name: Armor Break Module
coreItems.description: Shots do extra damage against armor when all locks are engaged.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 达到最大锁定上限时获得对护甲的额外伤害加成。

coreItems.name: Eraser
coreItems.description: Clean up the caves with an expanded magazine combined with the ability to acquire more locks.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 弹匣更大射个爽，锁定更多清矿场！

coreItems.name: Executioner
coreItems.description: Tweaks to the fire control mechanism and camera software bring lightning fast lock acquisition and more weakspot damage when all locks are used. However, the max number of locks is reduced as is the magazine and total ammo capacity.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 对火控系统和影像识别软件进行调整后使你能超快地锁定敌人，并且在达到满锁定层数时造成更多弱点伤害。但会降低最大锁定层数，弹匣容量和备弹量。

coreItems.name: Explosive Chemical Rounds
coreItems.description: Every enemy with 3 locks triggers an explosion on the last shot.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 敌人被锁定 3 层以上时，命中其的最后一发子弹将引发爆炸。

coreItems.name: Seeker Rounds
coreItems.description: Locked shots will always hit their target even finding their way around heavy armor and the system can maintain locks at more extreme angles. However the extra processing load reduces the rate of fire for locked shots and more care must be taken when reloading the advanced rounds.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 锁定后的子弹将必定命中目标，且设法在命中前绕过重型敌人的护甲；系统也可以在更极限的角度维持锁定。然而额外的弹道处理荷载延长了每发子弹的射击间隔，更换改良子弹的弹匣时也要更加小心。

coreItems.name: Neuro-Lasso
coreItems.description: Slow down enemies by locking on to them, the more locks the slower an enemy gets! However the locks can only be maintained for a limited time before the system resets.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 锁定敌人可使其减速，锁定层数越高，减速效果就越强！然而锁定系统会在开启锁定后的一段时间自行重置。

coreItems.name: Liquid Cooling System
coreItems.description: Extremely efficient cooling system that helps the weapon generate slightly less heat, makes it cool faster and will spend less time jammed.
coreItems.weaponZh: 柯莱特 微波烹调者
coreItems.descriptionZh: 加装极致高效的冷却系统，略微减少武器产生的热量，能够加快武器的冷却速度并缩短过热持续时间。

coreItems.name: Super Focus Lens
coreItems.description: A lens add-on that focuses the microwaves significantly, enhancing their damage output for up to 4 meters.
coreItems.weaponZh: 柯莱特 微波烹调者
coreItems.descriptionZh: 一种可大幅聚焦微波的镜头附件，能够提升武器在 4 米距离内的伤害。

coreItems.name: Diffusion Ray
coreItems.description: With some mechanical stress to the heat generator the microwaves can penetrate deeper, being able to go through several enemies at once and slows them down. However the stress takes its toll on the generator and decreases its damage output slightly.
coreItems.weaponZh: 柯莱特 微波烹调者
coreItems.descriptionZh: 对加热器施加一些机械压力后可使微波穿透到更深处，使其可以一次性穿过多名敌人并降低它们的移动速度。但这种压力会对加热器造成影响并略微降低武器伤害。

coreItems.name: Mega Power Supply
coreItems.description: A bit on the larger side, but with a few modifications to the weapon you can now use the most powerful power source R&D could smuggle back from the black market. The extra energy boosts rate of fire and total ammo at the cost of a lower cooldown and longer unjam duration.
coreItems.weaponZh: 柯莱特 微波烹调者
coreItems.descriptionZh: 在经过一系列改造后，武器现在可以兼容研发部从黑市里淘来的最强劲的供电装置了（虽说大了点）。装置额外提供的能量在提高总载弹量的同时也提高了射速，但会降低冷却速度并延长过热后冷却时间。

coreItems.name: Blistering Necrosis
coreItems.description: Adding an experimental electron tube makes the microwaves generate more heat, boiling the skin of enemies in the shape of large blisters. The blisters bypass armor, enhances incoming direct damage and hurts the target when popped. The large amounts of heat generated comes at the price of a lower cooldown rate.
coreItems.weaponZh: 柯莱特 微波烹调者
coreItems.descriptionZh: 加装一根实验性真空管之后会使微波产生更多热量，在敌人的表皮上烧出一大块脓包，这些脓包会无视护甲，提高目标受到的直击伤害并在破裂时对目标造成伤害。它所产生出的大量热量会导致武器冷却速率降低。

coreItems.name: Gamma Contamination
coreItems.description: Installing a lens of uranium glass cranks the radioactivity of your microwaves to 11. Hit targets have a chance to be contaminated with radiation, suffering damage and emitting harmful radioactive waves to nearby enemies. The small size of the lens reduces microwave impact radius and damage, while the amount of power required reduces total ammo.
coreItems.weaponZh: 柯莱特 微波烹调者
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将透镜改换为铀玻璃材质可以让微波的放射性更上一层楼。被命中的目标有概率沾染辐射污染，承受放射性伤害的同时向周围的敌人释放有害的辐射。但透镜的较小尺寸限制了微波的作用半径和伤害，额外所需的耗能也降低了其续航。

coreItems.name: Efficiency Tweaks
coreItems.description: Careful tweaking has resulted in greater charge capacity as well as an increase in total capacity.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过精心调整，武器的电容与电池容量都有所增加。

coreItems.name: Automated Beam Controller
coreItems.description: Removing manual control and automating the fire sequence improves speed of operation and allows for a significant expansion of the total battery capacity. However the charge capacity had to be reduced to prevent overheating. Manually interrupting the beam stresses the capacitor, resulting in a loss of some of the remaining charge.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 移除手动控制功能，将武器改装为自动化开火，在加快武器响应速度的同时还给电池匀出不少位置。不过电容容量做了适当削减以防止武器过热，同时强行中断射线将造成电容过压，并导致流失该次射击剩余的部分能量。

coreItems.name: Feedback Loop
coreItems.description: Heavy modifications to the weapon keeps excess energy within the beam, increasing the radius and damage of the area of effect while the beam is fired. However the changes leave little room for the battery, reducing the maximum energy capacity of the weapon.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 大量的改造使得这件武器能够汇集光束射击过程中产生的额外能量，使得在持续射击下，光束的覆盖范围和范围伤害都将持续提升。然而这些改动挤占了电池的空间，大幅减少了电池的最大容量。

coreItems.name: Volatile Impact Reactor
coreItems.description: A mixture of high energy and atomic frequency tuning lets you temporarily turn dirt and rock into magma, damaging and potentially igniting any enemy that walks across it.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过特定的原子调频，光束所携带的巨大能量可以在命中到泥土和岩石时，临时性地将其溶解成熔岩，对任何在上面行走的敌人造成伤害并点燃它们。

coreItems.name: Plastcrete Catalyst
coreItems.description: The beam has been finely tuned to violently react with plascrete platforms, significantly increasing AoE damage and range. If the beam is held long enough the reaction becomes unstable causing a powerful explosion damaging everything in a wide area. The tweaks reduce total capacity and come with a limited charge rate to avoid frying the circuits.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过精密调整后的光束可与注胶混凝土平台发生剧烈反应，显著提升范围伤害和作用半径。当光束持续与平台进行反应，反应的稳定性将逐渐降低，并于光束命中点产生大范围猛烈爆炸。为了避免烧毁电路，改动同时限制了电容容量和充电速率。

coreItems.name: Overdrive Booster
coreItems.description: Drastically increase the energy throughput by pressing the reload button while a beam is firing. Unfortunately maintaining control requires that you stand still while firing a boosted beam and the weapon cannot stop firing once boosted until the capacitor is fully discharged. Manually interrupting the beam stresses the capacitor, resulting in a loss of some of the remaining charge.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 在射击过程中按下换弹键来大幅提升能量输出。不过为了控制住强化射线，你必须老老实实站到电容完全放电。强行中断射线会对电容产生压力，并导致流失该次射击剩余的部分能量。

coreItems.name: Re-atomizer
coreItems.description: A charge so powerful it splits and rebinds atoms in hit enemies, spreading ailments to other targets behind them.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 强大的能量足以将敌人体内的原子分裂出来，连带着其身上的疾病重组到之后的敌人身上。

coreItems.name: Ultra-Magnetic Coils
coreItems.description: Extremely magnetic coils able to store more energy. The extra energy increases the radius and duration of the trail left behind by the projectile.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 使用了可以储存更多能量的超强磁力线圈，额外的能量提升了弹丸发射后产生的尾迹的半径和持续时间。

coreItems.name: Backfeeding Module
coreItems.description: The electrical flow is reversed by adding a tiny module onto the battery, increasing the amount of power it can store. However the extra efficiency of the reversed flow results in shorter lived trails.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 通过在电池组上加装一个小小模块来产生反向电流，电池整体续航提升，但额外的能耗产生缩短了尾迹的持续时间。

coreItems.name: The Mole
coreItems.description: R&D are proud of this one. A bullet that uses the traction from impacting with terrain to generate energy, making it travel further and do more damage. The extra energy required to fire The Mole comes with the cost of charge speed.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 研发部为此感到自豪：这种弹丸可以利用贯穿地形产生的牵引力来获取额外动能，使其行进更远、造成的伤害更高。缺点是发射“鼹鼠”所需的额外能量降低了武器的充能速度。

coreItems.name: Hellfire
coreItems.description: By using a highly volatile injection fuel a full charge pushes the trail temperature so high it will quickly ignite almost anything. The huge amounts of energy required increases charge time and reduces battery capacity, while shortening the trail duration.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将发射所使用注液替换为高能喷射燃料，使得武器在完全充能后射出的弹丸尾迹温度足以点燃任何物体，但射击所需的巨大能量使得充能速度、电池容量，以及尾迹的持续时间都有所减少。

coreItems.name: Triple-tech Chambers
coreItems.description: Prototype chamber tech that allows the weapon to fire off residual energy up to two times in quick succession after shooting, at half the energy cost and 75% damage of a normal shot. The extra shots don't penetrate and the heavy modification takes a toll on the energy flow, reducing charge rate and reload speed.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 原型枪膛技术，允许武器在蓄力射击后的短时间内，利用枪膛内残留的能量进行至多两次补射。补射伤害为正常射击的 75%，弹药消耗为正常射击的 50% ，但无法穿透任何物体。同时受到武器过度改造导致的电压影响，武器的充能速度和换弹速度降低。

coreItems.name: Quick Fire
coreItems.description: R&D improved the reload mechanism of the crossbow, making it pull back sooner for you to put a bolt in the chamber. They also reinforced the string free of charge, enabling the crossbow to fire bolts with little to no drop.
coreItems.weaponZh: 尼桑卡 X-80 “闪电鲨” 战术弩
coreItems.descriptionZh: 研发部改良了十字弩的装填机制，能让你在把弩箭放入矢道时更快地拉弦到位。他们同时还免费强化了弓弦，使得射出的弩箭几乎没有下坠。

coreItems.name: The Specialist
coreItems.description: Extra potent special bolts and more of them. What more could you want?
coreItems.weaponZh: 尼桑卡 X-80 “闪电鲨” 战术弩
coreItems.descriptionZh: 你的特殊弩箭不仅更强力，而且数量也更多了。还要啥自行车？

coreItems.name: Cryo Bolt
coreItems.description: A small module based on the Cryo Grenade tech has been strapped to your bolts, enabling them to cool and freeze enemies. Pin them to the ground or the face of enemies and turn any bugs in near proximity into popsicles. The intense cold takes a toll on the bolt, reducing overall damage and destroying it after use.
coreItems.weaponZh: 尼桑卡 X-80 “闪电鲨” 战术弩
coreItems.descriptionZh: 搭载基于急冻手雷技术制成的小装置的弩箭，可以降温并冻结敌人。将弩箭射到地上或敌人身上，将周围的虫子变成异虫碎冰冰。而作为提供强大制冷效果的代价，是更低的直接伤害，与弩箭命中后即毁。

coreItems.name: Fire Bolt
coreItems.description: Bolts with highly advanced cannisters full of volatile chemicals, with the ability to radiate intense heat. Shoot it at your enemies or the ground to activate it. The high temperature comes at a cost though, reducing overall damage and rendering the bolt useless after impact.
coreItems.weaponZh: 尼桑卡 X-80 “闪电鲨” 战术弩
coreItems.descriptionZh: 搭载满载烈性化合物的先进容器的弩箭，可以散发极高的热量。将弩箭射到地上或敌人身上即可释放化合物。而作为提供强大制热效果的代价，是更低的直接伤害，与弩箭命中后即毁。

coreItems.name: Bodkin Points
coreItems.description: The crossbow has been modified so it can fire a thinner bodkin point bolt with the ability to penetrate targets and ricochet to the nearest target. Its thin frame makes it do less damage and requires a slower reload process. This however does not affect special bolts.
coreItems.weaponZh: 尼桑卡 X-80 “闪电鲨” 战术弩
coreItems.descriptionZh: 十字弩经过改造后可发射一种更细小的锥头箭，这种弩箭可以穿透目标并弹射到它附近的敌人上。由于它的结构更加细小，它所造成的伤害更低，装填时需要的时间也更长。该超频模组不影响特殊弩箭。

coreItems.name: Trifork Volley
coreItems.description: With a few adjustments to the firing mechanism and the string you can load a volley of three bolts into the chamber. The bolts do a tad less damage, but are packed compactly enough for you to carry more of them. The modifications and size of the bolts makes reloading slower, and the bolts are ruined after firing them, making them unretrievable. This does not affect special bolts.
coreItems.weaponZh: 尼桑卡 X-80 “闪电鲨” 战术弩
coreItems.descriptionZh: 在对十字弩的击发机构和弓弦进行过一些调整后，你现在可以装填三根一组的弩箭了。虽然这种弩箭造成的伤害较少，不过它们小巧的体积可以使你多带上几组。这项改造因弩箭体积原因会使换弹速度变慢，且弩箭射后即毁，无法回收。该效果不影响特殊弩箭。

coreItems.name: Burst Fire
coreItems.description: R&D has fitted a cam mechanism into the GK2's fire control group, putting the rifle into a fixed 3-round burst fire mode. Additional modifications include a small increase to magazine size, damage and higher stun chance.
coreItems.weaponZh: 深核 GK2 突击步枪
coreItems.descriptionZh: 研发部往 GK2 的扳机组内加装了一个凸轮，使该枪的射击模式变为固定的 3 发点射。另外略微提升了弹匣容量、伤害，以及击晕概率。

coreItems.name: Mortar Rounds
coreItems.description: The weapon has been reworked to fire heavy mortar projectiles. These modifications slow down the rate of fire significantly -- but even if you can't carry as many, the high-explosive rounds more than make up for it in damage. Just remember to account for drop.
coreItems.weaponZh: “雷暴云砧” 重型双管机炮
coreItems.descriptionZh: 这把武器经过重新改造后能够发射重型迫击炮弹。这些改造会大幅降低武器射速。虽然可携带的弹药数量没以前那么多了，但在高爆炮弹的强劲火力面前，这都称不上是问题——只是别忘了开火前先计算下抛物线。

coreItems.name: Marked For Death
coreItems.description: Focus Shot now fires a dart loaded with an inflammatory catalyst which causes enemies to temporarily take more damage from all sources. While faster to focus, the direct impact of these darts does negligible damage, and requires an increased Focus Shot ammo cost as well as a smaller magazine.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 瞄准射击将射出装载炎症催化剂的毒镖，使被命中的敌人短时间内受到更多伤害。虽然瞄准所需时间缩短不少，但毒镖的伤害可以说是微乎其微，瞄准射击所需的弹药量增加，可装载的子弹量也受到影响。

coreItems.name: Pump Action
coreItems.description: Converts the weapon into a whopping 6-gauge pump action capable of dealing massive damage and punching through multiple enemies. The intrusive old-school pump mechanism requires a smaller magazine, and you can't fit as many of these big ol' shells in your pockets.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将武器改装成能够穿透多个敌人并造成巨额伤害的 6 号超大口径泵动式霰弹枪。为了适应这“经典”的泵动结构，弹匣被更换为较小的型号，所能携带的大口径霰弹相对较少。

coreItems.name: Crystal Nucleation
coreItems.description: A new cryoctane fuel blend creates razor-sharp formations of ice crystals on impact with terrain, which damage and slow enemies attempting to walk through them. These ice crystals melt over time, but can be maintained by cooling them. This modification results in a smaller overall fuel tank capacity to make room for the new fuel injector.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 一种新型低温烷冷冻剂，在接触地形时会凝结锋利的冰晶结构，对穿行其中的敌人造成伤害并降低移动速度。冰晶会随时间融化，但可通过低温冷却的方式延续。此项改造需为新型冷冻剂注入器腾出空间，因此冷冻剂储罐总容量有所减少。

coreItems.name: Scorching Tide
coreItems.description: A supercharged injection system and integrated duckbill choke allows the weapon to blast a blistering horizontal wave of flame by holding reload. Using this mechanism eats up additional fuel and makes the weapon unstable, reducing movement speed during charging.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 经过加压的燃油注入系统和集成式鸭嘴型喷口，使武器可通过按住换弹键射出一道横向的高温热浪。使用此功能需要消耗额外的燃料，并且会降低武器稳定性，减缓充能期间的移动速度。

coreItems.name: Rotary Overdrive
coreItems.description: Overtunes the electric drive to push the fire rate to its limit! But the resulting increase in heat buildup requires a mechanism allowing injections of Quik-Chill coolant fluid by pushing reload. This coolant reduces heat buildup and can take the weapon out of an overheated state. Only a limited amount of coolant can be carried, and must be replenished via resupplies.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 大幅调整电机，使武器射速冲上理论极限！不过与此同时冲上极限的还有热量的堆积，使这把武器需要一套按下换弹键后就能注入“冻得快”冷冻剂的额外结构。这种冷冻剂可以降低积攒的热能，让武器脱离过热状态。可携带的冷冻剂数量有限，且必须通过补给回复。

coreItems.name: Combustive Goo Mix
coreItems.description: Adding ammonium nitrate to the sludge mixture makes it explode when exposed to high temperatures. This new sludge mix has a thinner consistency, increasing the ammo cost of the pump's charged shot. It also smells even worse.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 往蚀泥中添加硝酸铵，使其能在接触到高温时爆炸。这种新式蚀泥混合物的结构稳定性更低，因此充能射击的弹药消耗变高了。这玩意还滂臭。

coreItems.name: SmЯt Trigger OS™
coreItems.description: A sleek new operating system from the SmЯt Corporation gives the weapon near-instantaneous lock-on, and automatically fires shots at locked-on targets. This system is quite CPU-intensive, however, lowering the maximum number of lock-ons.
coreItems.descriptionZh: “大聪明”公司旗下的全新超绝超流畅操作系统，能使武器在拥有近乎零延迟的锁定速度的同时，主动射击已锁定的敌人。不过这个系统比较吃 CPU，限制了最大锁定层数。

coreItems.name: Cluster Charges
coreItems.description: Each missile has had their explosives replaced with cluster munitions, and will eject these bomblets when you hold the reload button. The heavy payload has reduced the forward propulsion power of the missiles, as well as both total ammo and magazine capacity. On the bright side, all the extra weight and explosives mean the missiles hit like a truck if you don't release their payload before impact.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 将飞弹的战斗部替换为集束炸弹，按住换弹键即可释放子炸弹。装载集束弹药的重型弹头会拖慢飞弹的直线推进力，同时也减少了备弹和弹匣容量。不过好消息是，即使你不释放子炸弹，飞弹自身的威力也因超大的重量和超高的装药量而倍增。

coreItems.name: Conductive Thermals
coreItems.description: ElectroCryoThermic™ technology makes the plasma projectiles increase enemies' sensitivity to temperature changes and shock. However, the volatile plasma reaction does less direct damage, and generates more heat per shot.
coreItems.descriptionZh: “电化冰热”™ 技术使得电浆发射物在命中敌人时，提升其对温度变化和电击刺激的敏感度。然而更强烈的电浆反应降低了其直接伤害，并使每发射击产生更多热量。

coreItems.name: Hyperalloy Assembly
coreItems.description: Precision-tooled hyperalloy components drastically reduce bullet spread. However, the weapon frame no longer absorbs recoil, transferring all force directly to the user's wrist. This means increased recoil, as well as elevated risk of carpal tunnel syndrome.
coreItems.descriptionZh: 精密加工的超合金组件大幅降低了子弹扩散。然而这也导致后坐力将无法通过武器框架吸收以缓解，而是直接施加到使用者的手腕——简言之就是：更大的后坐力和患腕管综合征的几率。

weapons.name: Deepcore GK2

modules.name: Gyro Stabilisation
modules.description: Base accuracy improvement with pin-point accuracy on first shot.
modules.descriptionZh: 整体精准度提升，且武器最小扩散变为绝对精准。

modules.name: Quickfire Ejector
modules.description: Experience, training, and a couple of under-the-table design "adjustments" means your gun can be reloaded significantly faster.
modules.descriptionZh: 长期经验、刻苦训练，外加那么亿丢丢的私下“改动”使得武器的换弹更加迅速。

modules.name: Supercharged Feed Mechanism
modules.description: We overclocked your gun. It fires faster. Don't ask. Just enjoy. Also probably don't tell Management, please.
modules.descriptionZh: 我们超频了你的枪，现在它射得更快了。别多问，这种东西小范围享受就可以了。也别让管理层知道。

modules.name: Expanded Ammo Bags
modules.description: You had to give up some sandwich-storage, but your total ammo capacity is increased!
modules.descriptionZh: 你不得不少带几个三明治，但你的总备弹量增加了！

modules.name: Increased Caliber Rounds
modules.description: The good folk in R&D have been busy. The overall damage of your weapon is increased.
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部加班造成的身体与精神上的伤害，换取了武器的整体伤害提升。

modules.name: Floating Barrel
modules.description: Sweet, sweet optimization. We called in a few friends and managed to significantly improve the stability of this gun.
modules.descriptionZh: 完美，精致的优化。在摇了几个人后，我们设法让这把枪的稳定性显著提高了。

modules.name: High Capacity Magazine

modules.description: A bolt fitted with small generators that electrify targets and are able to connect to other nearby Taser Bolts through an electric arc. The electric surge renders the bolt unretrievable after use.
modules.descriptionZh: 一种装有小型发电机的弩箭，可使目标触电，并且可与附近其他电击箭产生电弧。但弩箭产生的电涌会导致弩箭在发射后无法回收。

modules.name: Special Bolt: Chemical Explosion
modules.description: A bolt filled with sulfuric acid that is injected into the target bloodstream on impact and creates a violent chemical reaction in contact with the benzoquinone compound of dying enemies.
modules.descriptionZh: 一款装载了硫酸的弩箭，在击中目标时硫酸会被释放入血，并且在与垂死敌人体内的苯醌化合物接触时产生剧烈的化学反应。

modules.name: Special Bolt: Pheromone
modules.description: A dart filled with a mixture of pheromones which releases in contact with targets and makes allies turn against it. Although low on damage its size allows more to be carried at once.
modules.descriptionZh: 一种装有小型信息素混合物罐的弩箭，在击中目标时会释放罐子内的信息素，使目标的友军开始攻击它。 虽然伤害很低，但它的大小允许你一次带上一大包。

modules.name: Special Bolt: Taser
modules.description: A bolt fitted with small generators that electrify targets and are able to connect to other nearby Taser Bolts through an electric arc
modules.descriptionZh: 一种装有小型发电机的弩箭，它可以让目标触电，并且可与附近其他电击箭产生电弧。

modules.name: Broadhead Bolts
modules.description: More mass, greater impact and able to dig just a tad deeper into enemies, increasing the overall damage.
modules.descriptionZh: 质量更大、冲击力更强，也就扎得更深。提升整体伤害。

modules.name: Expanded Special Quiver
modules.description: It's a bit on the heavier side, but your total special bolt capacity is increased.
modules.descriptionZh: 多少有点重，但你同时可以携带的特殊弩箭变多了。

modules.name: Increased Quiver Capacity
modules.description: It took a bit of rearranging, but you can now carry more bolts.
modules.descriptionZh: 稍微整理箭袋之后，你可以携带更多弩箭了。

modules.name: Reinforced String
modules.description: A reinforced synthetic fiber string that increases the velocity of your bolts, making them travel faster and further.
modules.descriptionZh: 一根由强力合成纤维制成的加强弓弦，可以提高箭矢飞行速度，使它飞得更快更远。

modules.name: Stabilizing Arm Brace
modules.description: R&D has fitted you with an arm brace that stabilizes your arm, which enables flawless motion allowing you to reload and switch ammo types faster, without risk of injuries.
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部为你配备了一个臂架，可以使你的手臂保持稳定，以便用完美的动作快速装填或更换弩箭，并且不用担心受伤。

modules.name: Battle Frenzy
modules.description: Move faster for a short time after killing an enemy.
modules.descriptionZh: 击杀敌人后获得短暂移速加成。

modules.name: Radio Transmitter Module
modules.description: All bolts and your crossbow are fitted with a small radio transmitter that allows calling back retrievable bolts from a distance by hovering your crosshair over them.
modules.descriptionZh: 你的十字弩和所有弩箭都装备了一个小型无线电发射器，允许你通过将准星悬停至弩箭处远程收回弩箭。

modules.name: Stabilizing Arm Brace
modules.description: R&D has fitted you with an arm brace that stabilizes your arm, which enables flawless motion allowing you to reload and switch ammo types faster, without risk of injuries.
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部为你配备了一个臂架，可以使你的手臂保持稳定，以便用完美的动作快速装填或更换弩箭，并且不用担心受伤。

modules.name: Banshee Module
modules.description: Tiny devices are attached to your bolts that emit a fear inducing high pitched noise for a limited time. Can be reset and reused if picked up.
modules.descriptionZh: 装载在弩箭上的小装置，可以在一定时间内持续发出引起敌人恐惧的尖锐声音，且装置可在捡起后重置并重复利用。

modules.name: Magnetic Shafts
modules.description: Bolt shafts made of a magnetic material that is attracted by electricity, pulling them towards electrified enemies or enemies affected by an electric field. The magnetic pull causes them to deal more damage on impact.
modules.descriptionZh: 弩箭的杆身由可被电流吸引的磁性材料制成，这使得弩箭可被触电或身处电场中的敌人所吸引，所产生的磁性拉力将会对敌人造成更高伤害。

modules.name: Magnetic Shafts
modules.description: Bolt shafts are made of a magnetic material that is attracted by electricity, making them pull towards electrified enemies or enemies affected by an electric field.
modules.descriptionZh: 弩箭的杆身由可被电流吸引的磁性材料制成，这使得弩箭可被触电或身处电场中的敌人所吸引，所产生的磁性拉力将会对敌人造成更高伤害。

modules.name: Potent Special Bolts
modules.description: A more potent version of your special bolt that increases its duration.
modules.descriptionZh: 更强效的特殊弩箭延长了其效果的持续时间。

weapons.nameZh: 尼桑卡 X-80 “闪电鲨” 战术弩

modules.name: Faster Turbine Spinup
modules.description: Start freezing things as soon as you pull the trigger with a near-instant turbine response.
modules.descriptionZh: 瞬时响应的涡轮系统，让你在扣下扳机的瞬间就开始向周围的敌人散播低温。

modules.name: Larger Pressure Chamber
modules.description: Lets you shoot for a longer time before needing to refill the pressure chamber.
modules.descriptionZh: 在压力仓需要重新加压前能喷射更长时间。

modules.name: Stronger Cooling Unit
modules.description: Freeze things at a faster rate.
modules.descriptionZh: 加快冻结速度。

modules.name: Stronger Cooling Unit

modules.descriptionZh: 加快冻结速度。

modules.name: Bypassed Integrity Check
modules.description: If you completely empty the pressure chamber, the weapon will immediately start repressurizing, safety be damned!
modules.descriptionZh: 当压力仓被完全清空后，武器会立刻开始重新加压。虫群冻开花，安全去他妈！

modules.name: Larger Reserve Tank
modules.description: You had to give up some sandwich-storage, but your total ammo capacity is increased!
modules.descriptionZh: 你不得不少带几个三明治，但你的总备弹量增加了！

modules.name: Overclocked Ejection Turbine
modules.description: Increases the effective range of the weapon.
modules.descriptionZh: 提升武器的有效射程。

modules.name: Improved Pump
modules.description: Refill the pressure chamber faster.
modules.descriptionZh: 更快地重新填充压力仓。

modules.name: Increased Chamber Pressure
modules.description: Shoot longer before needing to repressurize.
modules.descriptionZh: 在重新加压前能喷射更长时间。

modules.name: Increased Flow Volume
modules.description: We overclocked your gun. It fires faster. Don't ask. Just enjoy. Also probably don't tell Management, please.
modules.descriptionZh: 我们超频了你的枪，现在它射得更快了。别多问，这种东西小范围享受就可以了。也别让管理层知道。

modules.name: Sticky Flame Slowdown

modules.descriptionZh: 穿过火墙的生物会受到减速。

modules.descriptionZh: 促进射流中的冰晶形成，提升直接伤害。

modules.name: Supercooling Mixture

modules.descriptionZh: 提升冰流的热容量以更快冻住目标。

modules.descriptionZh: 提升冰流的热容量以更快冻住目标。

modules.name: Cold Radiance
modules.description: Any enemy that strays close to you while firing the Cryo Cannon will start to freeze.
modules.descriptionZh: 使用急冻炮时，自身周围的所有敌人都会开始冻结。

modules.name: Fragile
modules.description: There is a chance that frozen targets will spontaneously shatter!
modules.descriptionZh: 被冻结的敌人有几率直接碎裂！

weapons.name: Experimental Plasma Charger

modules.name: Higher Charged Plasma Energy
modules.description: More bang for the buck! Increases both the direct and area damage of the charged projectile!
modules.descriptionZh: 让爆炸来得更猛烈一些！提升充能发射物的直接伤害和区域伤害！

modules.name: Increased Particle Density
modules.description: Improves the damage caused by the normal shots.
modules.descriptionZh: 提升普通射击造成的伤害。

modules.name: Larger Battery
modules.description: The good thing about clips, magazines, ammo drums, fuel tanks ...you can always get bigger variants.
modules.descriptionZh: 要说弹夹、弹匣、弹鼓、燃料箱的共同优点... 你总能找到比它们大一点点的型号。

modules.name: Heat Shield
modules.description: Reduces how fast the weapon overheats when holding a charged shot.
modules.descriptionZh: 降低维持充能时武器过热的速度。

modules.name: Overcharged Plasma Accelerator
modules.description: You need to be a physicist to understand how it works but this little wonder increases the velocity of the EPC's normal projectile.
modules.descriptionZh: 具体的机制少说也得有物理学位才能理解，但用矮人听得懂的话来讲：这个小玩意会提升蓄能手枪普通发射物的速度。

modules.name: Crystal Capacitors
modules.description: Prepare a charged shot much faster.
modules.descriptionZh: 充能射击更快准备好。

modules.name: Improved Charge Efficiency
modules.description: Each charged shot uses less energy.
modules.descriptionZh: 每发充能射击消耗更少能量。

modules.name: Tweaked Radiator
modules.description: Increases the rate at which the weapon sheds heat, letting you shoot more rounds before overheating and also recovering faster from an overheat.
modules.descriptionZh: 提升武器散热效率，让你在过热前能多射几枪，也能让武器从过热中更快恢复。

modules.name: Expanded Plasma Splash
modules.description: Greater damage radius for the charged projectile explosion.
modules.descriptionZh: 提升充能发射物爆炸的伤害半径。

modules.name: High Density Battery
modules.description: The good thing about clips, magazines, ammo drums, fuel tanks ...you can always get bigger variants.
modules.descriptionZh: 要说弹夹、弹匣、弹鼓、燃料箱的共同优点... 你总能找到比它们大一点点的型号。

modules.name: Reactive Shockwave
modules.description: More bang for the buck! Increases the damage done within the Area of Effect!
modules.descriptionZh: 让爆炸来得更猛烈一些！提升武器的范围伤害！

modules.name: Burning Nightmare
modules.description: A modified containment field causes regular and charged shots to heat up the target proportionally to the amount of damage dealt. The modification also makes the charged projectile pass through all enemies dealing damage while it flies but it no longer explodes on impact.
modules.descriptionZh: 改造后的收容力场能使普通射击和充能射击对目标施加与伤害量成正比的热量。这项改造还可以让充能发射物穿透路径上的所有敌人并造成伤害，但代价是发射物受到冲击时不会发生爆炸。

modules.name: Flying Nightmare
modules.description: The charged projectile deals damage to nearby enemies as it flies.
modules.descriptionZh: 充能发射物在飞行途中对附近敌人造成伤害。

modules.name: Plasma Burn
modules.description: A modified containment field causes regular shots to heat up the target proportionally to the amount of damage dealt.
modules.descriptionZh: 修改过的收容力场能使普通射击加热目标，加热量正比于造成的伤害。

modules.name: Plasma Splash
modules.description: A simple modification to the containment field causes it to rupture outward on impact damaging all things in a small radius even through heavy armor.
modules.descriptionZh: 对收容力场稍微调整过后使得等离子体在击中物体时炸裂，对小范围内的所有物体乃至重甲单位造成伤害。

modules.name: Thin Containment Field
modules.description: A weaker containment field produces less heat for both charged and normal shots. Be aware that any high-energy impact will destabilize the charged projectile, causing a large area implosion.
modules.descriptionZh: 较弱的收容力场能减少充能射击和普通射击所产生的热量。请注意，任何高能冲击都会引爆充能发射物，造成大范围的内爆。

modules.name: Unstable Containment Field
modules.description: Any high-energy impact will destabilize the Charged Projectile causing a large area implosion. The weak field takes less energy to create and so the weapon no longer overheats after each charged shot.
modules.descriptionZh: 任何高能冲击都能使充能发射物不稳定，使其产生更大范围的内爆。弱力场需要更少的能量去创造，因此在每次充能射击后武器不再过热。

weapons.nameZh: 实验性等离子蓄能手枪

modules.name: High Capacity Tanks
modules.description: The good thing about clips, magazines, ammo drums, fuel tanks ...you can always get bigger variants.
modules.descriptionZh: 要说弹夹、弹匣、弹鼓、燃料箱的共同优点... 你总能找到比它们大一点点的型号。

modules.name: High-Pressure Ejector
modules.description: Increases the range of the flame for long distance incineration.
modules.descriptionZh: 提升火焰射程，以便从更远距离点燃敌人。

modules.name: Sticky Flame Duration
modules.description: Sticky flames duration increase
modules.descriptionZh: 提升火墙持续时间。

modules.name: Triple Filtered Fuel
modules.description: Fire it up! You set things ablaze much faster. Time to watch the world burn...!
modules.descriptionZh: 烧起来！你更容易把东西点燃了。是时候让世界陷入一片火海了......！

modules.name: Unfiltered Fuel
modules.description: The good folk in R&D have been busy. The overall damage of your weapon is increased.
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部加班造成的身体与精神上的伤害，换取了武器的整体伤害提升。

modules.name: More Fuel
modules.description: You had to give up some sandwich-storage, but your total ammo capacity is increased!
modules.descriptionZh: 你不得不少带几个三明治，但你的总备弹量增加了！

modules.name: Oversized Valves
modules.description: Increased fuel consumption rate for more damage
modules.descriptionZh: 提升燃油流通速率来产出更多伤害。

modules.name: Sticky Flame Slowdown

modules.descriptionZh: 穿过火墙的生物会受到减速。

modules.name: It Burns!

modules.descriptionZh: 敌人有几率在你火焰持续的燃烧下恐惧地逃开。

modules.name: More Fuel

modules.descriptionZh: 受到直接伤害致死的敌人有几率爆炸。

modules.descriptionZh: 让爆炸来得更猛烈一些！提升武器的范围伤害！

modules.name: High Velocity Grenades
modules.description: We souped up the ejection mechanisms of your gun, so the projectiles are now fired at a much higher velocity.
modules.descriptionZh: 我们强化了武器的发射结构，现在弹头的初速比原来高了一大截。

modules.name: Incendiary Compound
modules.description: 50% damage converted to heat. This will reduce direct damage, but will set enemies on fire.
modules.descriptionZh: 将 50% 的伤害转换为热量。这将减少直接伤害，但会使敌人着火。

modules.name: Pressure Wave
modules.description: We're proud of this one. Armor shredding. Tear through that high-impact plating of those big buggers like butter. What could be finer?
modules.descriptionZh: 护甲破坏——我们的自豪之作。撕裂那些大号虫子的高密度外骨骼的体验就跟抿黄油一样，纵享丝滑。还有比这更棒的东西吗？

modules.name: Concussive Blast
modules.description: Stuns creatures within the blast radius
modules.descriptionZh: 击晕爆炸范围内的生物。

modules.name: Homebrew Explosive
modules.description: More bang for the buck! Increases the damage done within the Area of Effect!
modules.descriptionZh: 让爆炸来得更猛烈一些！提升武器的范围伤害！

modules.name: Homebrew Explosive
modules.description: More damage on average but it's a bit inconsistent with a spread of 80% to 140%
modules.descriptionZh: 平均伤害提升，但单发伤害会在 80% 至 140% 区间浮动。

modules.name: Nails + Tape
modules.description: Fire in the hole! The Area of Effect is increased. (We advise keeping the term "safe distance" close to your heart)
modules.descriptionZh: 炸个痛快！爆炸范围增加。（我们建议使用时将“安全距离”这个词牢记于心。）

modules.name: Disabled Inertia Inhibitor
modules.description: This tweak ensures that the user's velocity is transferred to the projectile. Useful in high-speed applications but it requires doing more math in your head.
modules.descriptionZh: 这个调整能让发射物继承使用者的速度。在高速移动时很有用，但是你在脑内估计弹道时要多做些计算。

modules.name: Proximity Trigger
modules.description: Launched grenades will only detonate when they are in close proximity to an enemy or after the projectile comes to a complete stop. Explosion range is also increased. Note: The trigger takes a moment to arm, indicated by a green light, and until then the grenade functions as usual.
modules.descriptionZh: 发射出去的榴弹只有在足够靠近敌人或完全静止的时候才会引爆。爆炸范围也略微增加。注：感应触发存在启动时间，启动后榴弹将闪烁绿光。感应启动前榴弹性质与普通榴弹无异。

modules.name: Spiky Grenade
modules.description: Deals damage on direct impact
modules.descriptionZh: 榴弹直接命中敌人将对其造成伤害。

weapons.nameZh: 深核 40mm 便携式榴弹发射器

modules.name: Increased Blast Radius
modules.description: R&D improved the fuel consumption rate of your missiles, leaving more fuel on impact and causing a bigger explosion.
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部的小伙子们改进了你的飞弹的燃料消耗率，现在飞弹命中目标时能残留更多的燃料，并从而产生更大的爆炸。

modules.name: Missile Belts
modules.description: Extra missiles stored in fancy belts. One for each shoulder!
modules.descriptionZh: 整整齐齐排满额外飞弹的花哨弹带，每个肩膀都能挂一条！

modules.name: Pressurized Gas Cylinder
modules.description: With gas cylinders filled to the brim your missiles really pack a punch!
modules.descriptionZh: 让你的飞弹在被压得不能再满的气缸的助推下创得更狠！

modules.name: Anti-Tank Missiles
modules.description: These anti-tank missiles will crack those big bugs' plating like an egg!
modules.descriptionZh: 这些反坦克飞弹射穿大号虫子的外骨骼简直易如反坦！

modules.name: Bigger Jet Engine
modules.description: The engines in your missiles have been replaced with more powerful variants, increasing their max velocity and turn rate.
modules.descriptionZh: 将飞弹里的推进器更换为更强力的型号，提升最高速度和转向速度。

modules.name: Improved Feed Mechanism
modules.description: R&D improved the feed mechanism of this bad boy, making it fire faster!
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部改进了这把小坏蛋的供弹结构，提高了它的射速！

modules.name: Nano Missiles
modules.description: Half the size, but just as lethal. Your magazines can store a lot more missiles now.
modules.descriptionZh: 尺寸减半，但依然致命。你的弹匣现在可以储存更多的飞弹。

modules.name: Shrapnel Load
modules.description: R&D packed a little surprise in the missile heads that will tear those creatures' fleshy bits to shreds.
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部在飞弹的弹头里装了一点小惊喜，足以把那些虫子撕成渣渣。

modules.name: Zip Fuel
modules.description: With this high energy fuel the impact force of your missiles hit like a truck.
modules.descriptionZh: 这些高能燃料能给你的飞弹赋予泥头车般的冲击力。

modules.name: Napalm-Infused Rounds
modules.description: 33% damage converted to heat. This will reduce direct damage, but can set enemies on fire.

modules.name: Nitroglycerin Compound

modules.name: Uncontrolled Decompression

modules.descriptionZh: 研发部的人员们猛地给了每发飞弹一扳手，让它们的爆炸波更有精神了。

modules.name: Expanded Ammo Bags

modules.name: Increased Caliber Rounds

modules.name: CCD Array Add-on

modules.descriptionZh: 新增的感光耦合元件提升了武器在失去锁定前可旋转的最大角度，同时允许武器锁定更广角度内的敌人。

modules.name: Macro Lens

modules.name: Macro Lens
modules.description: The Macro Lens decreases the size of the lock on area for extra tight control and focused targeting while also greatly extending the lock on range.
modules.descriptionZh: 微距镜头牺牲锁定区域的大小，以换取更易的操控性与单体锁定，同时也大幅增加了锁定距离。

modules.name: Zoom Lens
modules.description: The Zoom Lens increases the range of your camera, enabling you to lock on to targets farther away.
modules.descriptionZh: 变焦镜头提升了镜头的采样距离，使你可以在更远处锁定敌人。

modules.name: Electro-Chemical Rounds
modules.description: A simple copper wire and some reactive chemicals makes your rounds pack an extra punch in contact with electricity and high temperatures.
modules.descriptionZh: 一根简单的铜线和一些活性化学品能让你的子弹对触电和燃烧的敌人造成更高伤害。

modules.name: SmЯt Targeting Software™
modules.description: This premium software update makes your camera prioritize targets with lower health and avoids placing more locks than necessary. Now that's SmЯt™!
modules.descriptionZh: 该款付费软件升级能让镜头优先锁定生命值更低的目标，同时避免锁定层数超过击杀所需层数。真是个“大聪明™”！

modules.descriptionZh: 优秀工程设计、精密激光切割，和来自研发部精心调整的相辅相成之下，武器的后坐力大大减少。

modules.name: Bigger Pellets
modules.description: The good folk in R&D have been busy. The overall damage of your weapon is increased.
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部加班造成的身体与精神上的伤害，换取了武器的整体伤害提升。

modules.name: Improved Stun
modules.description: Stun enemies more often and for a longer time!
modules.descriptionZh: 击晕更频繁触发且持续时间更长！

modules.name: Tungsten Coated Buckshot
modules.description: We're proud of this one. Armor shredding. Tear through that high-impact plating of those big buggers like butter. What could be finer?
modules.descriptionZh: 护甲破坏——我们的自豪之作。撕裂那些大号虫子的高密度外骨骼的体验就跟抿黄油一样，纵享丝滑。还有比这更棒的东西吗？

modules.name: Miner Adjustments
modules.description: Fully automatic with an increased rate of fire
modules.descriptionZh: 射击模式变为全自动，同时射速提升。

modules.name: Turret Whip
modules.description: Shoot your turrets to make them create an overloaded shot
modules.descriptionZh: 射击你的炮台将使其进行过载射击。

modules.name: Air Sensitive Compound
modules.description: When the goo is exposed to air it expands, making puddles cover a larger area on impact.
modules.descriptionZh: 蚀泥在接触到空气后膨胀，在受到冲击后可以形成更大的蚀泥坑。

modules.name: Better Air Pressurizer
modules.description: The air pressurizer is improved, making the projectiles travel faster and further.
modules.descriptionZh: 更好的气体压缩器使发射物可以飞得更快更远。

modules.name: High Capacity Tanks
modules.description: The good thing about clips, magazines, ammo drums, fuel tanks ...you can always get bigger variants.
modules.descriptionZh: 要说弹夹、弹匣、弹鼓、燃料箱的共同优点... 你总能找到比它们大一点点的型号。

modules.name: Atomizer Nozzle
modules.description: With the Atomizer Nozzle your charged shot will leave behind more fragments on impact.
modules.descriptionZh: 装上雾化喷嘴后，充能射击的发射物能够产生更多蚀泥块。

modules.name: Dyse Nozzle
modules.description: With the Dyse Nozzle your charged shot is launched with more force, making it more damaging on impact.
modules.descriptionZh: 高压喷嘴使你的充能射击在发射时力量更强，以此在撞击时造成更大伤害。

modules.name: Potent Goo Mix
modules.description: Normal shots do more damage on impact.
modules.descriptionZh: 普通射击在撞击时造成更大伤害。

modules.name: More Goo Canisters
modules.description: You had to give up some sandwich-storage, but your total ammo capacity is increased!
modules.descriptionZh: 你不得不少带几个三明治，但你的总备弹量增加了！

modules.name: Supersaturation
modules.description: The goo goes through a process of supersaturation after impact, making the effects and puddles last longer.
modules.descriptionZh: 蚀泥受到冲击后将经历过度饱和过程，使蚀泥坑与腐蚀效果的维持时间变得更长。

modules.name: Improved Spooling Mechanism
modules.description: The spooling mechanism has been improved and can get you to a full charge faster!
modules.descriptionZh: 改良的搅拌装置使你的充能更加迅速！

modules.name: Spillback Extension
modules.description: With the Spillback Extension added to the nozzle you spend less goo when charging.
modules.descriptionZh: 在喷嘴上安装回流配件，减少了充能射击的蚀泥消耗。

modules.name: Fluoroantimonic Acid
modules.description: A new and improved goo recipe with very aggressive properties makes every second in it more hellish!
modules.descriptionZh: 全新改良的蚀泥配方，具有超强酸性，在这种蚀泥里的每一秒都更加痛苦。

modules.name: Ingredient X
modules.description: R&D mixed the goo with a nasty secret ingredient that melts away the plating of goo covered enemies in record time!
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部在蚀泥中添加了一种危险的机密原料，使得被蚀泥覆盖的敌人的护甲会在创纪录的时间内被融化！

modules.name: Protein Disruption Mix
modules.description: Disrupting the protein molecules in the goo mix has made it more rigid and harder for creatures to move through greatly increasing enemy slowdown from both direct hits and puddles.
modules.descriptionZh: 破坏蚀泥混合物中的蛋白质分子使其更加粘稠，使生物更难在里面移动。大幅增强直击和蚀泥坑的减速效果。

modules.name: Expanded Ammo Bags

modules.descriptionZh: 你不得不少带几个三明治，但你的总备弹量增加了！

modules.description: More electric damage
modules.descriptionZh: 更多电击伤害

modules.name: Electric Arc
modules.description: Chance for electrocution to arc from one target to others
modules.descriptionZh: 有几率产生电弧使目标附近的单位触电。

modules.name: Improved Accuracy
modules.description: Better alignment and weight distribution means more shots hitting your target.
modules.descriptionZh: 更好的瞄具校准与配重调整使得武器能够更易更多地命中目标。

modules.name: Magazine capacity tweak
modules.description: Greatly increased magazine capacity
modules.descriptionZh: 大幅增加弹匣容量。

modules.descriptionZh: 特制的扳机组允许你快速射出两发子弹，速度快到第一发的后坐根本影响不到第二发的精度，当然武器本身的扩散另当别论。快速且紧密的射击也尤其适合用于破甲。但为了防止武器在你手中炸膛，每轮点射之间必须进行等待。

modules.description: This little tweak reduces weapon recoil and spread per shot helping you hit consecutive shots.

modules.name: Acid-tipped Bullets
modules.description: Bonus corrosive damage
modules.descriptionZh: 可造成额外的腐蚀伤害。

modules.name: Blowthrough Rounds
modules.description: Shaped projectiles designed to over-penetrate targets with a minimal loss of energy. In other words: Fire straight through an enemy!
modules.descriptionZh: 异形弹头被设计成能以最小的动能损失穿透目标的造型。换句话说：一发直接射穿一个敌人！

modules.name: Mactera Toxin-Coating
modules.description: Bonus damage against Mactera aliens
modules.descriptionZh: 对异虫蝇能够造成额外伤害

modules.name: Neuro-Corrosive Toxic Catalyst
modules.description: Causes a target affected by neurotoxins or corrosive sludge to temporarily take more damage over time. Any biological target that dies while affected will violently explode damaging everything in the vicinity. Multiple rounds increase the potency of the reaction and the size and power of the death explosion.
modules.nameZh: 神经性腐蚀毒素催化剂
modules.descriptionZh: 暂时性提升目标所受到的来自神经毒素或腐蚀性淤泥效果的持续伤害。在效果内死亡的生物目标将产生猛烈的爆炸，毁坏周围的一切事物。多次命中会增强该反应的效果，致使目标受到更多持续伤害并强化死亡时的爆炸范围及伤害。

modules.name: Volatile Bullets
modules.description: Bonus fire damage to burning targets.
modules.descriptionZh: 对点燃目标造成额外火焰伤害。

modules.name: Concave Lens
modules.description: A concave lens that curves the microwaves outward and increases their impact radius
modules.descriptionZh: 一面可将微波向外折射以增加伤害半径的凹透镜。

modules.name: Convex Lens
modules.description: A convex lens that focuses the microwaves and increases their damage output
modules.descriptionZh: 一面可将微波向内聚焦以增加伤害的凸透镜。

modules.name: Magnetron Tube
modules.description: Adding a powerful magnetron tube and a new capacitor increases the total ammo
modules.descriptionZh: 加装一个强力磁控管与一个全新的电容以提升总载弹量。

modules.name: Heat Sink
modules.description: Jamming a heat pipe into the magnetron seemed unsafe and irresponsible initially, but it really helped reduce heat build up!
modules.descriptionZh: 往磁控管里塞一根导热管看似既不靠谱又不安全，但它确实对减少热量累积有所帮助！

modules.name: Larger power supply
modules.description: By simply exchanging your power supply for a bigger model your rate of fire is increased
modules.descriptionZh: 通过简单地换装一个更大号的供电装置，武器的射速得到了提升。

modules.name: Thermoelectric Cooler
modules.description: R&D fitted your weapon with a thermoelectric cooler, increasing its ability to cool down faster
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部为你的武器加装了热电制冷器，以提高其冷却速度。

modules.name: Densification Ray
modules.description: Tweaking the transmitter wavelength causes microwaves to densify organic matter temporarily, making it harder for targets to move
modules.descriptionZh: 对发射器的波长进行调整后会使微波暂时提升有机物的密度，使目标难以行动。

modules.name: Temperature Amplifier
modules.description: A new hybrid circuit makes microwaves compensate for sudden changes in temperature, causing them to heat or cool burning or frozen targets further and radiate some of their temperature to surrounding enemies
modules.descriptionZh: 一种能够使微波对及时的温度变化作出调整的新型混合电路，从而进一步提升着火目标或降低被冻结目标的温度，并将部分的温度传递至附近的敌人身上。

modules.name: Power Supply Overdrive
modules.description: Push reload to put the power supply into overdrive, significantly increasing rate of fire. To compensate for the power flow the waves are focused inward at the cost of AoE radius. Push reload to deactivate it.
modules.descriptionZh: 按下换弹键使供电装置进入过载状态，进而显著提升射速。 作为能源流动的补偿措施，微波将会向内聚集并缩小作用范围。再次按下换弹键来解除使用。

modules.name: Wide Lens Add-on
modules.description: Push reload to activate the Wide Lens Add-on which curves the microwaves further, but the power required to use it takes a toll on the cooler, increasing heat per shot. Push reload to deactivate it.
modules.descriptionZh: 按下换弹键以激活广角镜附件，进一步扩大微波作用范围，但是所需的能量将会对散热器产生影响，从而增加每次射击所产生的热量。再次按下换弹键来解除使用。

modules.name: Boiler Ray
modules.description: Exposure to the microwaves cause the liquids within biological targets to expand, giving them a chance to explode.
modules.descriptionZh: 暴露于微波下会使生物目标的体液急剧膨胀，使得它们有几率爆炸。

modules.name: Contagion Transmitter
modules.description: A transmitter that enables rays to destroy poisoned and corroded cells in hit targets, increasing damage output with a chance to spread a poisonous vapor to nearby enemies.
modules.descriptionZh: 一种可使射线摧毁目标身上中毒或坏死细胞的传输器，在提升伤害的同时将有几率制造出会传播至附近目标的毒雾。

modules.name: Exothermic Reactor
modules.description: R&D has plugged in a temperature scrambler that makes the microwaves cause quick shifts in temperatures of burning or freezing targets with a chance of triggering a temperature shock that spreads a mist of extreme heat or cold.
modules.descriptionZh: 研发部在武器内部加装了一个温度扰频器，使微波可以快速改变燃烧或冻结着的目标的温度，并有几率触发散播高温或极寒雾气的温度骤变。
